channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ron Adams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ron Adams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Ron Adams
item.description:
Steve Kerr:

“Yeah. You guys know my love for Loon — on and off the court. We're gonna miss his screening. We're gonna miss his offensive rebounding. We're gonna miss just how solid he is every day. And yeah — the locker room leadership. You know, Ron Adams told me the other day — he said, ‘Loon might have been the best leader I’ve ever seen in my life.’ And yep, so I agree with that. I think Al will be able to give us some of that same kind of quiet leadership and mentoring in the locker room, and I’m thankful for that. But we’re gonna — we’re gonna really miss Loon.”

Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Oct 7, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Ron Adams
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, who is now in more of a consultant role:

“I think Ron is more important for *me* this year than ever.... As I navigate how to coach this team.”

Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Jan 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Mike Brown
item.description:
“Fundamental details. I’m seeing deficiencies where, with our last team, they just automatically made up for a mistake by making four straight 3s and blowing a game open. I’m now forced to figure out what the deficiency is and how to solve it. So I’m relying more on Mike Brown and Ron Adams for that. Both guys are more detailed than I am as a coach.”

Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Mike Brown, Dec 24, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Ron Adams
item.description:
“Somebody whose experience and wisdom made everyone stand up and listen. I knew right then that we were talking to the right guy, and I’m just thankful we have him because he’s been instrumental in all that we’ve done. “Ron Adams, he’s our Tex.”

Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Mar 1, 2018. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jared Sullinger on Ron Adams
item.description:
Sullinger has some credit to pass around for the Celts’ improvements on the defensive end.

“I think you’ve got to put a big chunk of that on Brandon (Bass) and a big chunk of that on assistant coach Ron Adams,”

Jared Sullinger on Ron Adams, Dec 6, 2013. Source: Boston Herald.
